faqs.question: How often should our Fire NOC be renewed?
faqs.answer: In Gujarat and Maharashtra, Fire Safety Certificates / Form-B must be submitted every six months or annually depending on occupancy class and building height under National Building Code (NBC) 2016 regulations.

faqs.question: Do you supply BIS and NFPA certified equipment?
faqs.answer: Yes. All hydrant valves, hoses, sprinkler heads, detectors, and extinguisher cylinders supplied by 4Way Safety Solutions carry genuine ISI marks and adhere strictly to IS/BIS & NFPA standards.

faqs.question: How do I know if my fire hydrant system needs repair?
faqs.answer: Watch for pressure gauge drops, leaking hydrant valves, rusty discharge water, jockey pump short-cycling, or a diesel pump that fails its weekly auto-start test. Any of these symptoms warrants an immediate inspection by our engineers.

faqs.question: Can you conduct hydraulic calculations & CAD designs?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our in-house design cell produces NBC/NFPA-compliant hydraulic calculations, pump and tank sizing, sprinkler demand curves, and stamped CAD layouts suitable for fire authority submissions.

faqs.question: How long does an initial Fire Safety Audit take?
faqs.answer: A typical industrial or commercial facility audit takes 1–2 working days on site, followed by a detailed compliance report within 3–5 working days, depending on plant size and documentation availability.

faqs.question: Should I inspect my system before buying or leasing a plant?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. A pre-purchase fire system due diligence audit identifies failed pumps, inadequate storage, expired cylinders, and NOC liabilities so these can be priced or remedied before handover.

faqs.question: What happens during a scheduled quarterly AMC inspection?
faqs.answer: Our technicians test pumps in auto and manual modes, verify panel health and battery backup, flow-test hydrants and sprinklers, inspect extinguisher pressures, and record everything in your digital compliance log.

faqs.question: How do I schedule an emergency site service?
faqs.answer: Call our 24/7 helpline at +91 95866 50088 or submit the quote form on this page. Emergency breakdown attendance is typically mobilised within 4–12 hours across Vapi, Daman, Surat, and Ahmedabad.
